name: B10-0222/2024 (The Left) – Human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling on the authorities in Kyrgyzstan to release opposition politician Temirlan Sultanbekov and two other party members arrested before local elections in Bishkek. It also asks Kyrgyzstan to stop cracking down on journalists, bloggers, human rights defenders and LGBTQI people, to repeal repressive laws, and to respect free speech, fair trials and free elections.

- Nothing changes in EU law; the Parliament only urges Kyrgyzstan to release detainees and repeal repressive laws.
- It affects Sultanbekov, two party members, journalists, bloggers, rights defenders and LGBTQI people in Kyrgyzstan.
- Next, the resolution is sent to European Union institutions, member states, and Kyrgyzstan's government and parliament.
